claim: Jimothy went viral in July 2026 from Kiana Hall's July 14 Instagram video and inspired a Google animation, bobblehead, Mariners merch and card giveaway, and a Fortnite appearance.
excerpt: Search summary: short spine syndrome; the July 14 video got about 8 million Instagram views (another summary: 10 million within one week); Mariners Salmon Run, special merchandise, card giveaway for Ballard Food Bank; Etsy full of paintings, sculptures, stickers, knit dolls; tattoos.
title: Jimothy (raccoon)
